jobs.title: Bilingual Prosci Instructor, France
jobs.description:
Position summary

Prosci Executive Instructors are dynamic teachers and facilitators, with a passion for change management and our client’s success. With deep business expertise, and a thorough understanding of Prosci’s change management research, methodologies, and tools, you will not only deliver a variety of programs designed to build the client's change management capabilities, but you will also help to establish Prosci as a valuable, long-term partner to organizations as they navigate their most critical change initiatives.  

Scope & Responsibilities 

Deliver a variety of programs on Prosci change methodology, tools, and research:

  • Instruct clients in Prosci’s proprietary change management methodology virtually, or at client locations or Prosci-selected venues across the Europe and EMEA 
  • Maintain up-to-date mastery of Prosci’s change management offerings
  • Combine career experience with Prosci methodology to illustrate real-world change management application and answer clients’ questions specific to their individual change initiatives
  • Prepare thoughtfully for sessions to provide incredible learning experiences for all participants
  • Serve our client relationships to establish Prosci as a valuable, long-term partner to organizations as they navigate their most critical change initiatives

Driving and Influencing Change: 

  • Foster a culture of adaptability and resilience within colleagues, customers, and program participants
  • Drive digital transformation by engaging in new technologies and processes to improve efficiency and competitiveness
  • Operates as a recognized expert to orient work in a workflow to plan, organize, and execute the steps it takes to achieve a goal to achieve higher efficiency. Typically known as a subject matter authority
  • Applies expertise to act as an authority to quickly identify and accurately articulate why a client does or does not want a change based on their business objectives and challenges

 

Managing Critical Relationships 

  • Develop a thorough understanding of the customers specific needs, objectives and challenges related to organizational change initiatives.  Actively listen and ask pertinent questions to uncover potential barriers or resistance factors
  • Offer expert advice, guidance and recommendations to clients based on your in-depth knowledge and experiences with Prosci tools and methodologies
  • Understand complex topics and processes required to mentor clients in applying Prosci methodologies within their environment
  • Actively seek feedback from colleagues and customers to identify areas for improvement and enhance the client experience

 

Business Development  

  • Collaborate with Product Development and Advisory to develop new offerings or enhance existing products
  • Craft compelling value propositions that highlight unique benefits of Prosci products or services
  • Engage in collaborative content creation and thought leadership opportunities such as white papers, articles, blog posts and webinars to actively engage current and former course participants
  • Assist the Growth team in addressing industry specific questions, objections, or concerns for prospective clients
  • Apply your industry expertise to identify and engage potential clients
  • Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with other businesses and organizations

Requirements

Technical/Functional Skills 

  • Change and Project Management experience in dynamic growth/change cultures (PMBOK, Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, Waterfall etc.)  
  • Intermediate MS Office skills with the ability to navigate a virtual learning environment
  • Demonstrated expertise in the Prosci portal tools including Proxima and Hub Suite is a strong plus
  • Proficient working in Zoom, Teams, WebEx, Salesforce and M365

 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree and advanced degree preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Diverse industry experience leading change from a consultative, project, program, or executive level in multiple industries (for-profit and not-for-profit), CDP industry
  • Demonstrated experience successfully engaging with employees undergoing change, practitioners leading change and senior leaders who sponsor change

 

Additional Preferences 

  • Engaging presentation and facilitation skills (both in-person and in virtual settings)
  • Advanced skill and mastery of adult learning theories and technique
  • Ability to incorporate relevant career experience and expertise into the learning environment
  • Expected 15+ years of industry experience
  • Experienced strategic leader directing a variety of functions and directing resources for a min. of 15+ years

Additional Role Data 

  • Position reports to: Director, Service Delivery 
  • Supervisory Responsibilities: No 
  • Key Stakeholders: Sales, Logistics, Scheduling, Advisors. 
  • Work location: Remote
  • Language: Native French and fluent in English (full professional proficiency), fluency in Spanish and/or Italian are a strong plus
  • Travel expectations: 50% of travel anticipated

 

About Prosci

Founded in 1994, Prosci is a global leader in change management and the provider of choice for 80% of Fortune 100 companies. Prosci combines scientific research with the people side of change to deliver results-focused solutions that enable clients to achieve change outcomes and grow organizational change capability. Prosci maintains the industry’s largest body of change management research—the basis for the company’s tools, methodologies, advisory services, and role-based development programs. To date, Prosci has certified over 100,000 change management practitioners worldwide.

The company is headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado, with offices in Europe, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia and Mexico , plus a number of Prosci Partners around the globe. Prosci is continually expanding directly and through its global partner network to ensure change success for clients no matter where they are located.

Prosci is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Employment opportunities at Prosci are available to all applicants, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics. You can learn more about our efforts to build a more inclusive, equitable and diverse organisation: https://www.prosci.com/about/dei.

By applying for this role you are consenting to your personal data being shared with Prosci Inc (US-based), or any of the Prosci Europe group of companies, registered and/or operating in Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Morocco, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Details of our registered companies and locations can be found on our website:  https://www.proscieurope.com/prosci-europe  This means that your data may be shared and/or stored outside of the country of application for up to 5 years, in the locations of any of the aforementioned countries or with Prosci Inc in the United States, for the purposes of reviewing your application and presenting you with any suitable future employment opportunities.

jobs.title: Principal, Global Campaign Operations
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal to lead global campaign operations at Prosci. You will turn Marketing plans for our Individual and Enterprise audiences into consistent, well-built campaigns across regions. 

You will own how campaigns are planned, built, tested and measured in HubSpot. You will direct a specialist partner team, and set the standards that let regional marketers move quickly while maintaining quality and governance. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be our senior Marketing-side expert in campaign operations and HubSpot, setting the operating model, standards and quality bar while directing specialist delivery support. You should be comfortable building and troubleshooting when needed, but your main job is making the whole campaign operation work well at scale.

Requirements

What you will do 

  • Partner with Individual, Enterprise and regional Marketing leaders to translate demand strategy into scalable campaign execution 
  • Own the end-to-end campaign process, from brief and plan to build, launch, QA and measurement, across email, nurture, webinars, events and landing pages 
  • Set global campaign standards, templates and processes that regional teams can use with confidence 
  • Act as the senior Marketing expert on how HubSpot is used for campaigns, including audiences, segmentation and automation 
  • Direct and quality-check the work of our specialist partner team 
  • Define campaign measurement requirements, and make sure every campaign has the right taxonomy, tracking and data structure so Marketing can understand what is working 
  • Own Marketing campaign activation across the website, including landing pages, forms, conversion paths and related content updates, working with Digital Experience on platform, development and broader website improvements 
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and standardize campaign operations, including appropriate use of AI 
  • Work with RevOps on lifecycle, routing and CRM data, and with reporting partners on what needs measuring 
  • Enable regional marketers to execute more independently, with clear standards, templates and guardrails 


What you bring 

  • 7+ years in marketing operations, including campaigns across multiple regions or markets 
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: workflows, lists, segmentation, email, landing pages and forms 
  • A working understanding of how HubSpot and Salesforce connect, and the judgment to know when a problem belongs with the CRM team 
  • Experience directing agency or partner teams and holding them to a clear quality standard 
  • A strong QA instinct: you catch the issue before it reaches a customer or a report 
  • Strong campaign measurement fluency, including tracking, UTMs, attribution concepts and the data foundations required for reliable analysis 
  • Clear writing, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues 


Nice to have 

  • HubSpot certifications 
  • Experience with consent and privacy requirements across regions, including GDPR 
  • Experience supporting ABM or BDR-led motions 
  • Localization and multilingual campaign experience 
  • Practical use of AI tools to automate or speed up campaign work 


How you will work with other teams 

Revenue Systems owns shared CRM administration and governance. Digital Experience leads the website platform and technical roadmap. Reporting partners own routine reporting delivery. You will work closely with each of these teams to make campaigns effective, measurable and well run. 

Your first 90 days 

  1. First 30 days: learn the campaign estate, the partner model and regional needs, and see where QA currently catches problems 
  1. By 60 days: run the campaign process end to end, and set the briefing and QA rhythm with the partner team 

By 90 days: establish the initial global campaign standards, templates and operating rhythm, and agree campaign measurement requirements with Marketing leadership and reporting partners 

Work Location: Remote within the US.


Compensation: $86,400 - $108,000 USD is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate's overall qualifications and experience. This role is eligible for inclusion in our bonus program.


Benefits: Through our experience and strategic focus on the people side of change, we know that by taking care of our people, we are taking care of our business. In addition to the compensation detailed above, we offer comprehensive wellness benefits, including generous flexible paid time off, holidays and volunteer time, medical, dental, vision, long-term and short-term disability programs, life insurance, pet insurance, 401k with company matching, and access to LinkedIn Learning.  Our “mostly virtual” culture is vibrant with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, get involved in employee-led interest and resource groups, and to meet up with team members at in-person local or market-wide events.


We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every requirement listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Activation and Production Testing Specialist
jobs.description:
🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

  • High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape

  • Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability

  • Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers

  • Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision

  • Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

What You Will Do

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys organized work, clear communication, and getting the details right. You’ll start with established playbooks and test procedures, then help improve them as you learn the product and settle into the team.

  • Run activation workflows. Follow provider-specific manuals to submit onboarding requests and coordinate registrations, approvals, and contracting steps with identity providers. Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

  • Provide eID-specific activation guidance. When customer involvement is needed, explain the provider’s activation requirements, collect the necessary information, and guide customers through the steps they need to complete.

  • Recruit and manage production testers. Find and onboard testers for the countries and identity providers involved, confirm their eligibility and availability, explain what they need to do, and maintain an organized, reliable tester network.

  • Coordinate and run real-world tests. Once a customer has integrated our product, organize testing with real production testers. Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

  • Collect evidence and report results. Gather tester feedback and supporting evidence, check outcomes against the expected user flow, and produce clear reports showing what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what still needs attention.

  • Raise issues and follow through. Turn test findings into actionable issues with reproduction steps and relevant evidence. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and provider-facing teams, track progress, and arrange retesting when fixes are ready. You don’t need to fix the underlying code yourself, but you do need to keep the follow-up moving.

  • Keep people and information aligned. Maintain accurate records of activation status, test coverage, schedules, and blockers. Keep customers, testers, and internal teams informed, and flag missing information or schedule risks early.

  • Help improve how we work. As you gain experience, identify recurring friction and improve checklists, documentation, and handoffs. You’ll also help monitor existing operational automations, check their outputs, and flag exceptions or improvement opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You are detail-driven and dependable. You can follow defined processes consistently, check information carefully, and complete repeatable work without losing accuracy or leaving loose ends.

  • You work in an organized way. You can manage multiple requests and test schedules, keep records current, and follow up with the right people to meet agreed timelines.

  • You communicate clearly and patiently. You’re comfortable working with customers, external testers, and identity providers. You can explain instructions, ask useful questions, and keep people informed without overwhelming them.

  • You are good at gathering and structuring information. You can turn scattered feedback, screenshots, and observations into a clear test report or issue that someone else can act on. You distinguish confirmed findings from things that still need investigation.

  • You have practical technical curiosity. You can learn your way around APIs, credentials, configuration settings, and test versus production environments. You don’t need to be a developer or an identity expert, but you should be comfortable reading documentation and following technical instructions.

  • You know when to ask for help. You recognize when something falls outside the playbook, escalate with useful context, and handle credentials and tester information carefully.

  • You want to grow beyond the checklist. You’re happy to learn established workflows first, then use what you’ve learned to suggest practical process improvements. We don’t expect you to arrive with every answer.

  • You work comfortably in Korean and English. You can communicate with local teammates and international customers, testers, and providers, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Bonus: Experience in customer onboarding, operations, testing coordination, technical support, or customer success. Familiarity with B2B SaaS or digital identity is helpful, but not required.

⚡️ Fast Facts

  • 💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors

  • 📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library

  • 🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs

  • 🔬 82 eID research projects completed

  • 🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation

🎁 Benefits & Culture

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-friendly work model

  • Real ownership from Day 1

  • High-impact, global product

  • Multicultural, respectful team

🧭 Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Intro Call (30 min) – Get to know Hopae

  2. Functional or Technical Interview (45 min) – Dive into your skills

  3. Culture Fit Conversation (45 min) – Collaboration & alignment

  4. Offer 🎉

jobs.title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
jobs.description:
Über VIA HealthTech

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat.

Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf.

Die Rolle

Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus.

In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht.

Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.
  • Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen.
  • Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt.
  • Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert.
  • Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut.
  • Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF.
  • Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen
  • Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle
  • Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden
  • Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt
  • Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert
  • Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen
  • Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2), auch Schweizerdeutsch, gutes Englisch
  • Verfügbarkeit am frühen Abend. Unsere Zielgruppe ist häufig erst nach der letzten Sitzung erreichbar, Termine zwischen 17 und 19 Uhr gehören dazu. Im Gegenzug gestaltest du deinen Tag frei

Von Vorteil

  • Französisch und/oder Italienisch, um später auch die weiteren Gebiete anzusprechen
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der Schweizer Psychotherapie- oder Psychiatrieszene
  • Erfahrung mit Funnels, in denen Marketing und Vertrieb ineinandergreifen: Performance-Marketing, Webinare, Trials, Self-Service
  • Anerkennung als Psychotherapeut:in, psychologische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen
  • Vertriebserfahrung mit Praxen, Heilberufen oder Spitälern in der Schweiz
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Sales-Automation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder Outbound-Tooling
